content.thinking:
The document looks clean, so I'm noting what's there. The terms section contradicts itself: it says EXW, which puts freight on the buyer, but then says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the seller. I'm flagging that as a red flag. The total price isn't shown, and I'm starting to pull the line items, beginning with the quantity of 9000 from the order acknowledgment.

I'm pulling the remaining figures now: a unit price of 6.11 USD, the confirmed date of April 13, 2026, and the order date of March 10, 2026 from the header.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26550446 from Boise Semiconductor to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318634 (dated 2026-03-10). One line: 9,000 pcs of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD each, confirmed for 2026-04-13. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The delivery-terms text is internally inconsistent: it says EXW and that DDP is not agreed, but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice.
red_flags: Terms contradict each other: EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges and pays freight) and 'DDP is not agreed', yet freight, insurance and duties are said to be prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice, which means extra charges beyond the unit price.
No total value and no document date are shown on the acknowledgement.
observations: Clean printed single-page document; no handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines in the table but is fully readable.
